advertise verb

Traupman 130
M-O

prōscrībere

Classically, post a notice, e.g. of a house for sale.

Other words

  • praescrībō, praescrībere, praescrīpsī, praescrīptum — not “advertise”: write before, prescribe

    verb, third conjugation · avoid · classical · Traupman 269

    Traupman gives praescrībō here, but elsewhere prōscrībō, which is the classical word for publishing a notice of sale; praescrībō is to write at the head, to prescribe.

See also advertisement.
